name: Cycles - Maintenance Cycle Engine
description: Cycle CRUD, triggers (calendar/hours/count), winner logic, suspension, missed-cycle detection, idempotent evaluation emitting cycle.due events

CycleCreate.description: Data model for creating a new maintenance cycle

cycles.evaluate_due.description: Evaluate all active cycles for due triggers

cycles.detect_missed.description: Detect missed cycles past due without trigger

core.ModuleBase: Implemented with name, version, dependencies, profiles
core.event_bus: Publishes cycle events, subscribes to cycle.due for logging
core.logger: Structured JSON logging with module namespacing
core.utils: utcnow(), new_id() for timestamps and IDs

api.RequestContext: Extracts org_id, user_id, role from claims

templates.template_validation: Validates assigned_template_id exists before cycle creation

cache.lock: Distributed locks for idempotency (per-cycle + global eval lock)
cache.rate_limit: Manual trigger rate limiting (10 per minute)

key_features.winner_logic: FIRST satisfied trigger wins - only one WO per evaluation
key_features.suspension: SUSPENDED cycles skip evaluation, calendar triggers pause
key_features.missed_detection: Separate beat task detects overdue cycles without trigger
key_features.manual_trigger: Rate-limited (10/min), MANUAL launch mode only, audited
key_features.snapshot_isolation: Cycle updates apply only to NEW work orders, existing WOs keep old snapshots

restrictions: CYCLES never calls WORKORDERS directly - emits cycle.due events only
Changes to cycles apply only to newly generated work orders
Manual triggers only allowed for MANUAL launch mode cycles
Calendar triggers require valid cron expression (5-field format)
Maximum 10 manual triggers per minute per cycle (rate limit)
Single-flight evaluation prevents duplicate processing across cluster
recommendations: Integrate 'croniter' library for production-grade cron parsing
Implement SQLAlchemy ORM models for cycles, cycle_triggers, cycle_evaluations tables
Add telemetry/metrics for evaluation latency and failure rates
Consider adding cycle.copy() for duplicating cycles across zones
Implement cycle statistics endpoint (avg completion time, compliance %)
Add support for timezone-aware cron scheduling (currently UTC only)
notes: Module follows DDD patterns established in previous chunks
Event-driven architecture: CYCLES emits, WORKORDERS will subscribe to cycle.due
Idempotency ensures no duplicate work orders even with concurrent evaluations
Placeholder DB operations ready for SQLAlchemy model integration
All API routes properly secured with RBAC guards
Beat schedules registered for automatic evaluation and missed detection

dependencies_chain.chunk_1: core (ModuleBase, event bus, registry, logger, utils)
dependencies_chain.chunk_3: api (Router, RequestContext, pagination), worker (tasks, beat schedules)
